known_issues.description: The preserved pre-fix canonical output omits the native-text party name TIGER GLOBAL INTERNATIONAL IV HOLDINGS for Civil Appeal 263 and has incorrect cover-page order. StructuredParser now recovers the name from the native text layer, merges recovered blocks into the detected multi-appeal cover layout by bounding-box rows, and reorders only that recognized cover. Stable block IDs retain their original parser identity and therefore need not be numerically sequential in visual reading order.

The preserved pre-fix chunking-result.json contains paragraph 5.4 both in TABLE block page-8-block-0 and TEXT block page-8-block-1. Native inspection confirmed it is a Docling table caption referenced as #/texts/1, also independently yielded by iterate_items(), and not present in table.data.table_cells. StructuredParser now serializes the table without captions while retaining the caption text block and its provenance.
